about: signals.promptugal.news's observability lane (signals.b@PrompTugal.dinis, 18 November 2026, at Dinis's word, kept in PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-five-sites-on-account-b.md and 2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md). assets/obs/obs.js writes page views and reads only to lanes.signals. The lane has no append tokens yet: making them in signals.b@'s session was refused by the session's permission check on 18 November 2026, so the list is empty and nothing is sent. The drain key, the endpoint and the vault are read from promptugal.news's published obs.json (shared_from) unless set here.
what: This site counts page views and reading time, publicly, as promptugal.news does: no IP address kept, no cookie, no user-agent string, no fingerprint. Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control and Pause in the footer turn it off. Not counted yet: the signals lane has no tokens. What is counted: https://promptugal.news/newsroom/observability/index.html
